guide: scripts
every numbered lab script, in the order the tutorial runs them -- start here when you want to know what a cell actually did
fpga/pynq-z2/modelblaster
the compiler and runtime that lower a network onto the board: the IR, the passes, the scheduler's input
fpga/pynq-z2/modelblaster/kernels
the int8 kernels the accelerator really runs, in C, one directory per target (pext, pext_nl, roccmoon)
fpga/pynq-z2/host
the host side the notebook calls: bitstream load, clocks, the board drivers
fpga/pynq-z2/sw
the bare-metal C that runs on the Rocket core itself
fpga/pynq-z2/src
the Verilog top level, and how the accelerator is wired to the core
boards
the Chipyard board configuration this bitstream was elaborated from
samples
the Zephyr applications on the board -- OLED, camera, boot info
zephyr-chipyard-sw
the Zephyr workspace and the XPU-RT scheduler.  Large: a built toolchain lives under tools/, so browse zephyr_ws/ and not the toolchain
expected
the golden outputs a gate compares against -- what 'correct' is defined to be
docs
the design notes and the reproduction guides
patches
what had to be changed in upstream projects to make this stack build
